narrative: Email regarding an unexpected dividend credit payout.

message.body: Dividend Disbursement Notice: A dividend payment of ₹850 from your mutual fund holdings was processed. Please verify your mandate details on our portal.

evidence.label: Mutual Fund Asset Management Company
evidence.value: Mutual fund portal confirms dividend declared, but list of official registrars is unconfirmed.

consequence_text.safe: You verified dividend payouts directly with your mutual fund manager before clicking links.
consequence_text.unsafe: Proceeding without verifying dividend registrars can lead to phishing.

teaching_point: Verify financial disbursements with your primary asset manager before taking online action.
